questions.question: Why are there so many historic shrines and temples in Kyoto?
options: Kyoto is the largest city in Japan today.
The temples were all built in modern times for tourists.
Kyoto is the only city with maple trees.
Kyoto had previously been the capital of Japan for over a thousand years.
questions.answer: Kyoto had previously been the capital of Japan for over a thousand years.
questions.explanation: （題目為 AI 依課文命題，答案依課本內容）課本 p.107：Having previously been the capital of Japan for over a thousand years, the city boasts a large number of historic shrines and temples.

questions.question: Which statement about the Golden Pavilion Temple is NOT true?
options: It is surrounded by a dry landscape.
It is covered in sparkling gold leaf.
It is one of Kyoto's most photographed landmarks.
It is a three-story pavilion with a pond in front of it.
questions.answer: It is surrounded by a dry landscape.

questions.question: According to the text, what makes a true geisha?
options: She must live in a temple.
Besides a distinctive appearance, she must master instruments, songs, and literature and be able to perform the kyomai dance.
Only her white makeup and red lipstick.
questions.answer: Besides a distinctive appearance, she must master instruments, songs, and literature and be able to perform the kyomai dance.
questions.explanation: （題目為 AI 依課文命題，答案依課本內容）課本 p.107～108：藝妓外表獨特（白妝、紅唇、雅致髮簪），但不只是外表讓她們出眾；她們花多年精通樂器、歌曲與文學，而且 no "person of art" could be a true geisha without being able to perform the traditional kyomai dance。

questions.question: What can be inferred about Kyoto?
options: Photos of it look very different depending on the season.
The city sees most of its visitors in summer.
Tours there are expensive because there are few of them.
Most famous buildings there were built in modern times.
questions.answer: Photos of it look very different depending on the season.

questions.question: The reading strategy "Visualizing" means ____.
options: finding the main idea in the last sentence
imagining you are at the scene and picturing details with different senses
looking only at the pictures and skipping the text
questions.answer: imagining you are at the scene and picturing details with different senses
questions.explanation: （題目為 AI 依課文命題，答案依課本內容）課本 p.104：Visualizing 是主動閱讀策略，讀者想像自己身在描述的場景，用不同感官想像物件與細節，幫助記住細節、生動理解；因背景知識不同，每個人想像的畫面可能差很多。

questions.question: "Ann was seen to steal the doll" and "Ann was seen stealing the doll" — what is the difference?
options: "to steal" is in the future; "stealing" is in the past.
"to steal" means the whole process was seen; "stealing" means she was seen in the middle of the act.
There is no difference at all.
questions.answer: "to steal" means the whole process was seen; "stealing" means she was seen in the middle of the act.
questions.explanation: （題目為 AI 依課文命題，答案依課本內容）課本 p.119：be seen/heard + to VR 表達做某事的完整過程都被看到或聽到；+ V-ing 表達做某事的當下被人看到或聽到。
